reasoning.why_fusion: Fusion achieves the best or near-best AUROC (0.9087), F1 (0.9255), accuracy (0.8968), and sensitivity (0.9227) among all core, directly-comparable (n=1395) experiments. It balances the CNN's local visual detail with the Foundation model's general representation.
reasoning.where_cnn_stronger: CNN has the highest specificity (0.8541) -- fewer false positives on benign cases.
reasoning.where_foundation_stronger: Foundation-only has the highest AUPRC (0.9326), suggesting strong precision-recall behavior, likely from its strong general-purpose pretraining.
reasoning.why_ensemble_not_selected: Validation-based weight search collapsed the ensemble to 100% Foundation-only weight, meaning it provided no combination benefit in this setup -- Fusion remains preferred as it demonstrates genuine complementary benefit from both branches.
reasoning.why_attention_grouped_exploratory: Only 13 test-set patient groups were available, giving high variance and low statistical confidence. Results (perfect sensitivity, high F1) are promising but not conclusive at this sample size.

overall_conclusion: Fusion is the recommended V1.0 model: it is the most consistently strong and balanced approach across metrics that are directly comparable at full test-set scale (n=1395).
